videos.title: Recruiting top talent isn't one pitch
videos.description:
Recruiting top talent isn't one pitch. It's a continual touchpoint approach that can take days, weeks, months, or years.

Adam Ward (Head of Talent at Cursor) on how he builds elite, high-talent-density teams.

videos.title: Scoping is the most under-invested step in hiring
videos.description:
If you can't objectively describe what "great" looks like for a role, you're not ready to hire for it.

Adam Ward (Head of Talent at Cursor) explains why.

videos.title: This is the biggest unfair advantage in recruiting
videos.description: Adam Ward (Head of Talent, Cursor) explains the number one driver of candidate satisfaction.

videos.title: How to get better referrals
videos.description:
How to get better referrals: stop asking who's talented. Start asking who's talented at exactly what you need.

Adam Ward (Head of Talent at Cursor) on sourcing top candidates the right way.

videos.title: "Remainder hiring is the output of the funnel of doom."
videos.description:
Only 20% of people reply to recruiting outreach. That 20% isn't necessarily the top 20%. 

Adam Ward (Head of Talent at Cursor) on the “funnel of doom,” and how to fix your hiring process.

videos.title: Do teams actually need PMs?
videos.description: Product management is a trade, not a qualification—a muscle built by reps—and every PM hired by default takes those reps away from engineers and designers, “infantilizing” people who are perfectly capable of good decisions but never had the opportunity to make them.
